slides.title: Early start: F1 & golf
slides.body: F1 Hungarian GP at 7:30 AM ET on Apple TV. Golf starts at 12:00 AM ET across ESPN+, CBS, NBC, Peacock, Fox, FS1, FS2, and Golf Channel.

slides.title: Four golf events
slides.body: PGA Tour, LPGA, LIV Golf, and Champions Tour all have events today. Check Golf Channel, ESPN+, CBS, NBC, Peacock, CNBC, Fox, FS1, and FS2.

slides.title: MLB all evening
slides.body: First pitch starts at 4:10 PM ET and rolls through the night. Watch on MLB.TV, Apple TV, ESPN Unlimited, and local team networks.

slides.title: Featured MLB games
slides.body: Yankees-Phillies, Dodgers-Mets, Braves-Orioles, Blue Jays-Red Sox, and Astros-White Sox headline the slate.

slides.title: Night soccer
slides.body: Bay FC vs Houston Dash and Chicago Stars FC vs Orlando Pride both kick at 8:00 PM ET on Victory+.
